# maple_alert_destination (Resource)

A notification channel that alert rules and uptime monitors deliver to. Credentials are write-only in the API, so Terraform cannot detect changes made to them outside Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "maple_alert_destination" "pagerduty" {
  type            = "pagerduty"
  name            = "Primary on-call"
  integration_key = var.pagerduty_integration_key
}

resource "maple_alert_destination" "webhook" {
  type           = "webhook"
  name           = "Incident bot"
  url            = "https://hooks.example.com/maple"
  signing_secret = var.webhook_signing_secret
}

resource "maple_alert_destination" "team_email" {
  type            = "email"
  name            = "Checkout team"
  member_user_ids = ["user_2abc…"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Display name.
- `type` (String) Channel type: `pagerduty`, `webhook`, `discord`, `telegram`, `google-chat`, `email` or `chat`. Changing it replaces the destination.

### Optional

- `bot_token` (String, Sensitive) `telegram`: the bot token.
- `channel_id` (String) `chat`: the channel to post to.
- `chat_id` (String) `telegram`: the chat to post to.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries are sent. Defaults to `true`.
- `integration_key` (String, Sensitive) `pagerduty`: the Events API v2 integration key.
- `member_user_ids` (List of String) `email`: the organization members to email.
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) `webhook`: secret used to sign each request (optional).
- `url` (String, Sensitive) `webhook`: the URL Maple POSTs to. Sensitive, since webhook URLs often carry a token.
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) `discord`, `google-chat`: the channel webhook URL.
- `workspace_id` (String) `chat`: the linked chat workspace. Changing it replaces the destination.

### Read-Only

- `channel_label` (String) Human-readable channel, as shown in Maple.
- `id` (String) The `dest_…` public ID.
- `summary` (String) One-line description of where alerts go.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import maple_alert_destination.example <id>
```
